title.zh: 将宿务省 Talisay 市镇的 Jaclupan 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Mohon (Divino Amore) 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Jaclupan National High School Extension in the Municipality of Talisay, Province of Cebu, From the Jaclupan National High School; and Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Mohon (Divino Amore) National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Jaclupan National High School Extension in the Municipality of Talisay, Province of Cebu, From the Jaclupan National High School; and Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Mohon (Divino Amore) National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Jaclupan Quốc gia tại Đô thị Talisay, Tỉnh Cebu khỏi Trường Trung học Jaclupan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Mohon (Divino Amore) Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Jaclupan แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Talisay จังหวัด Cebu ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Jaclupan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mohon (Divino Amore) แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Jaclupan Nasional di Kotamadya Talisay, Provinsi Cebu dari Sekolah Menengah Jaclupan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Mohon (Divino Amore) Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Jaclupan Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Talisay, Wilayah Cebu daripada Sekolah Menengah Jaclupan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Mohon (Divino Amore) Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Jaclupan National High School Extension in Barangay Motion, Municipality of Talisay, Province of Cebu, is hereby separated from the Jaclupan National High School in the Municipality of Talisay, and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Mohon (Divino Amore) National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Jaclupan National High School Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Mohon (Divino Amore) National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Jaclupan National High School Barangay Mohon Extension. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Mohon (Divino Amore) National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
